correctness.rationale: Fresh assessment of /workspace/repairs/4/RESULT.md: the repaired Finding concerns only the exact four-variable ordered-pair census. Binary conjunction and disjunction preserve monotonicity and both endpoints; conversely, minimal true sets of a monotone nonconstant map give a disjunction of nonempty conjunctions. Thus the test on the two endpoints and the 32 covering edges is necessary and sufficient for being a term function on four available variables. Monotone lower/upper slice comparison gives a second exhaustive enumeration because the restrictions to the two slices uniquely identify a truth table. My third enumeration generated upward closures of every nonempty antichain of nonempty assignments, including the singleton containing just the top, and tallied all ordered XOR masks. It independently gives 166 functions, 3605 distinct masks and the exact 15 cells of the repaired table with total 166^2; I parsed the repaired table and compared it to that fresh exact replay. Replay: python3 /workspace/review_replay.py 4. No uploaded script was run. The repair corrects the claimed Python floor of the uploaded checker to 3.10 for int.bit_count. The maximal-distance two orientations follow from connectivity of the interior comparability graph. The original general mask and spectrum statements are mathematically correct; they are now credited and proved briefly as context rather than claimed as the distinct contribution. The histogram is exact for ordered pairs, with replacement, on truth functions at this arity only. No cross-arity extrapolation or formal certification is claimed.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For any two upsets their XOR is (union) minus (intersection) and is order-convex. By the dual of the prior representation, a nonempty interior convex set is the difference of its upper closure and that closure minus the set; both upsets contain the top and omit the bottom and therefore arise as terms. The empty case uses equal terms. There is no new obstruction or count in that direct specialization. The canonical representation does not describe the number of realizing ordered pairs: changing the common portion of their true sets or their orientation on incomparable components can change this multiplicity without changing the mask. Consequently a support census or the general difference representation does not give the weighted distribution without a separate pair enumeration or a new counting argument.

For the repaired claim, monotone nonconstant functions are the upsets containing the top and avoiding the bottom. The cover graph of that interval admits a path of one-bit updates via the intersection, of length |U symmetric-difference V|, and no shorter path can update every differing bit. The graph-polynomial lookup surfaced general literature but no identified exact table for this interval; that search limit is not evidence of absence.

originality.rationale: PASS for the narrowed, re-audited Finding only. The original originality axis FAILS for presenting the order-convex realization theorem as a main new result: Elder et al. Proposition 2.5 gives a broader difference-of-ideals representation, and the dual with the endpoints imposed gives precisely the claimed masks; known counts yield 3605 by inclusion-exclusion. The formal Canonne definition also identifies the exact structural predicate. Neither that established representation nor the inspected counts and sampled-distance literature determine the ordered-pair multiplicity distribution as a direct specialization. Best of the checked evidence supports the exact, weighted four-variable histogram as a distinct remainder. Credit neither the count of term functions nor the general unweighted mask/spectrum observations as original.
residual_risks: An uninspected exact pair-distance table for a free distributive lattice, Dedekind lattice or its cover graph may cover the remainder. The bounded formulation and table searches do not establish absolute priority.
Same-day catalogue dates are not evidence of precedence. The removal of the original structural novelty claim rests instead on the published stronger representation.

value.rationale: The repaired contribution is the exact distribution for independent uniform nonconstant monotone-functions at a natural cutoff: arity four is where forbidden interior masks first appear, so it is the first case with nontrivial restrictions on disagreement shapes. The 15 multiplicities give a reference distribution for sampling validation and for frequency rather than existence questions about elementary equations, including the sparsely realized largest distances. Prior sampling diagnostics motivate this same distance observable. The covered distinct-mask count alone does not answer it. No larger-dimensional or downstream theorem is required for this exact benchmark.
